To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

situated learning occurs when there is a legitimate peripheral participation in communities of practice and that the learning process involves participation in the practice and the development of the legitimacy in the communities of practice.

the process of situated and legitimate peripheral participation in the learning process is influenced by the social relationships, which are developed in communities of practice, and by the negotiation and re-negotiation of meanings.
situated learning, participation and legitimacy in work practices are essential for the learning process.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the learning of workers, in the Dublin Irish Pub, in the work practices, and the participation in the communities of practice.
understanding the process of situated and legitimate learning in communities of practice in the workplace.
the learning process, the participation of learners and the legitimacy in communities of practice, and the learning process in organizations.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the legitimacy and participation of learners, through their actions, are essential to learning.
the process of learning situated in work practices is not only a process of learning of the individual, but a process in which the learning is collective.
situated learning is not only a process, but a system of learning, in which participation is a fundamental element for learning.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the process of situated and legitimate peripheral participation, as well as the levels of participation, is a fundamental aspect in the process of collective learning.
the legitimacy and participation of learners can assist in the development of learning.
the process of learning situated is developed through the legitimacy and participation, in the work practices and communities, in which people act.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the legitimacy and participation of the learners in work practices can be considered as a factor in the development of learning.
the learning in the workplace is a process of social interaction, which involves the participation of the members in the work practices and the legitimacy of their practices.
the process of learning in organizations is not only the acquisition of knowledge.
